definition: Along every accessibility edge w→v, each candidate existing at w also exists at v. Domains are extensions of the same Ontic.ExistsAt predicate on a fixed rigid candidate carrier, not changing carriers or counterpart identities.
note: Approved source-free semantic interface for fixed-roster actualist domain transfer. No physical or metaphysical domain policy is asserted. No free-logic proof calculus, counterpart semantics, or general quantified syntax is introduced.
